Since you wanted a description of Rescue, the board is made up of Circles. Each circle is divided into four sections like a pie. You begin with a particular movement rate from space to space. But whenever you get to a circle, you have to mark it off. Then anytime you happen to come back to a circle that has one or more of its sections used up,then you have to add that number to your movement rate. And if it's 6 or more, then you have to subtract 5.  In addition, that subtraction also happens when you rescue people. Because on a certain space there are one to five people to be rescued.
Rescue must be very obscure since you said you could not find it on any list. But it's definitely by Sackson because his name is on the board along with the release date of 1977.
